sources: Finance Bill 2025 — Section 194A threshold revisions (effective 1 April 2025)
Income Tax Act 2025 — Section 393(1) Sl.5(ii) (codes 1020/1021) from 1 April 2026

fd_interest.notes: TDS @ 10% if aggregate interest from bank/PO/co-op bank exceeds threshold; PAN not provided → higher rate may apply

scss_interest.notes: SCSS depositors are senior citizens — use seniorCitizenLimit (₹1L from FY 2025-26)

pomis_interest.notes: Post office deposit — general ₹50K / senior ₹1L threshold from FY 2025-26; monthly interest aggregated annually for TDS

nsc_interest.notes: TDS on accrued interest at maturity/premature encashment per rules

form15G15H.notes: No TDS if Form 15G/15H submitted and conditions met — out of scope for v1 automated tests
